description: Backcode guidelines outside Backcode: in repos connected to a project (on by default, in Remind mode, unless an admin sets them to Free), remind Claude to put every feature or fix in its own worktree and PR, and (when required) ask before a direct commit or push to the main branch. In any connected repo, a deploy Claude runs from Bash (and that prints its tool's success line) is recorded so the app's Pending deploys knows it. The runner decides; without it, nothing happens.

hooks.command: B="$(command -v backcode 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/.backcode/bin/backcode")"; [ -x "$B" ] && CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" "$B" hook session-start 2>/dev/null; exit 0
B="$(command -v backcode 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/.backcode/bin/backcode")"; [ -x "$B" ] && "$B" hook pre-tool-use 2>/dev/null; exit 0
B="$(command -v backcode 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/.backcode/bin/backcode")"; [ -x "$B" ] && "$B" hook post-tool-use 2>/dev/null; exit 0
